newsitem.title: JORDAN: IRAQ TO BUY 170,000 T FRENCH, U.S. WHEAT - TRADE.
newsitem.headline: IRAQ TO BUY 170,000 T FRENCH, U.S. WHEAT - TRADE.

text.p: Jordanian traders said on Tuesday Iraq was expected to buy shortly about 100,000 tonnes of French wheat and 70,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.

Paris-based grain traders said last week that Iraq had tendered to buy up to 100,000 tonnes of French wheat for shipment in September or October, and Jordanian traders said it could now be seeking another 70,000 tonnes from the U.S.
The deadline for offers in the tender is Friday, August 15.

European traders said last week Iraq had bought 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat at $187 per tonne including freight for delivery to the port of Umm Qasr, and the purchase may have been extended by a further 25,000 tonnes.
